# Coherent controlled powers: proof and validation packet

The current `Schema.power_sound` states literal iteration after fixing the
control bit. Before external use, connect that actual executable action to the
full coherent operator, including control off-diagonal terms and an arbitrary
reference. Keep the old theorem available; give the registry a stronger
component theorem once built and audited. External enablement stays false.

Implement total pointwise lifting of actual `applyStage`/`run` over control
sectors in the Mathlib-free runtime. Prove its relation to the existing literal
execution and checker. In the separate proof package, interpret that actual
action with complex matrix/vector multiplication. Show the accepted single
stage is diag(I,U^(2^k)); show the full schedule is the block diagonal family
U^j for the actual ordered control bits. Derive whole-space isometry from the
provider premise, and extend the full operator (not just branch probabilities)
by identity on arbitrary finite references. Retain the explicit provider
premise and the pending external IR/provider/evidence binding obligation.

The native oracle uses small exact Gaussian-integer vectors and monomial
providers with relative/global phase, independent Python matrix powers, and
correlated control/target/reference inputs. Include k=0..12, actual repetition
counts, metadata mutations and the X versus iX counterexample: for count 2,
controlled (-I) and controlled I have the same basis probabilities but different
coherences. All comparisons concern the actual new native coherent evaluator;
no approximate tolerance or unproved Rust/Lean adequacy is inferred.
